text: M-304 'VAV terminal units' heating paragraph describes an electric reheat coil, but the 19 VAV boxes on M-401 have no heater. The heating paragraph only applies to VAVE boxes.
M-304 sequence lettering skips D (AHU) and E (VAV/FVAV).
No exhaust fan schedule: EF-LAB, EF-RR, EF-CONT, EF-LOCAL appear only on M-104 and M-304.
FVAV15 heating cfm (360) is below its minimum primary cfm (840); every other FVAV has heating cfm about half of cooling.
BMS names differ from drawing tags on purpose (VAVE07 -> VAVE-07, CH01a -> CH-1A, AHU01 -> AHU-1): the merge step must link them.
